does_not_measure: execution-reachability. A module counted here is one an import path reaches from an entrypoint. It is NOT proof that anything runs: a module imported inside a CLI command counts as wired even when the code it exposes is never entered. An empty map means no module is unimportable -- it does not mean every subsystem executes.

modules.convergence_decision: cryptographic convergence receipts; runs once a campaign consumes them
